questions.question: What did Yaga tell Gakuganji about how Panda was created?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: Ultimately, Yaga lied, claiming he did not know how Panda had been created.

questions.question: What did Gojo accuse Gakuganji of at Tokyo Jujutsu High?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: being involved in orchestrating Yuji Itadori's death the previous month

questions.question: What did Gakuganji order his students to do before the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: Gakuganji ordered his students to kill Yuji and make it appear as an accident, reminding them not to hold back since Yuji was not human.

questions.question: What did Kamo answer when Gakuganji asked how to kill an enemy sorcerer?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: When Kamo correctly answered that one must kill a sorcerer using cursed energy to prevent them from becoming a curse after death, Gakuganji concluded that killing Yuji with cursed energy should suffice as long as Sukuna did not intervene.

questions.question: What did Yoshinobu explain to Aoi and Mei Mei about grade 1 sorcerers?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: Yoshinobu meets with Aoi and Mei Mei, and explains his opinion about what a grade 1 sorcerer is after he hears about Aoi Todo and Mei Mei's recommended sorcerers for promotion.

questions.question: What did Masamichi reveal to Gakuganji before he died?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: On the verge of death, Masamichi tells Gakuganji that someone can replicate a soul's information from physical information and that information has to be placed into a cursed corpse's core.
Panda tells him that he isn't like humans and human behaviors don't bind pandas.

questions.question: Why didn't Gojo kill Gakuganji for Masamichi's death?
questions.subject: Yoshinobu Gakuganji/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo tells him that he understands that he was ordered to do so by the higher-ups and that he feels it's not his place to judge him, as his unsealing caused him to be unable to protect Masamichi, he also tells Gakuganji that the fact he didn't disclose Panda's secret means he is trustworthy to an extent.
